# UiCheckbox

A single checkbox with an optional mixed state.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | inputs |
| Import | `import { UiCheckbox } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import UiCheckbox from '@your-scope/ui/components/UiCheckbox'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/inputs/UiCheckbox.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/inputs/UiCheckbox.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Label text. It is the accessible name of the control. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Helper text below the control, announced as its description. |
| `error` | `string \| readonly string[] \| null` |  | Error message(s). A non-empty value also marks the control invalid and is announced with it. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field as required: the native `required` attribute plus a decorative marker on the label. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control, with the native `disabled` attribute where the element has one. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the control invalid (`aria-invalid`) without showing a message. |
| `size` | `UiSize` |  | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `UiProvider` `defaults`, then to `ui.config.ts`. |
| `id` | `string` |  | Id of the native control. Generated (and stable) when omitted. |
| `controlAttrs` | `UiControlAttrs` |  | Attributes, listeners and a `ref` callback for the native control, for example Formisch's `field.props`. |

## Models

| v-model | Type |  | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `boolean \| null` | required | Checked state. `null`/`undefined` are treated as unchecked. |
| `v-model:indeterminate` | `boolean` | default `false` | Mixed state ("some selected"). It is the native `indeterminate` property, so it is announced as "mixed"; any user toggle clears it. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` |  | Label content (replaces `label`). |
| `hint` |  |  |

## Attributes

class/style go to the root; every other attribute and listener (and `controlAttrs`) goes to the native control.

## Keyboard

- Space toggles (native).

## Accessibility

- Native `<input type="checkbox">` inside its `<label>`: the whole row is the click target.
- `v-model:indeterminate` sets the native `indeterminate` property (announced as "mixed").
- On coarse pointers the row is at least 44px high.

## Styling

- `.vui-check`, `.vui-check__row`, `.vui-check__input`, `.vui-check__label`, `.vui-check__hint`
- `data-size`, `data-invalid`, `data-disabled`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/InputsDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/InputsDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="grid gap-1">
  <UiCheckbox v-model="terms" :label="t('demo.terms')" :hint="t('demo.email.hint')" />
  <UiCheckbox v-model="all" v-model:indeterminate="mixed" :label="t('demo.selectAll')" />
  <UiCheckbox :model-value="true" :label="t('demo.disabled')" disabled />
  <UiCheckbox
    :model-value="false"
    :label="t('demo.invalid')"
    :error="t('validation.accepted')"
    required
  />
</div>
```
